scope: Wallet withdrawal + deposit guard + notification/intent surfaces (mock-only, localStorage Next.js 16 MVP). No backend.

details.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output
details.reason: Fix requires `npm audit fix --force` which downgrades next to 9.x (major breaking change). Build-time CSS tooling only; not an app runtime input path. Tracked for a coordinated Next/postcss upgrade.

findings.observation: Unauthenticated access to /worker/dashboard redirects to /login; the 'Rút tiền' control is not reachable as a guest.
findings.test: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 8 — unauthenticated user is redirected away from the worker dashboard (no wallet access)

findings.observation: A withdrawal note containing is stored and rendered as inert escaped text via React; the payload does not execute and no injected element is created.
findings.test: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 8 — withdrawal note with an XSS payload renders as inert text (escaped, not executed)

findings.observation: walletStore.withdraw rejects zero/negative/non-finite amounts (INVALID_AMOUNT) and over-balance (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) with no ledger mutation; balance cannot be driven negative by a worker cash-out.
simulateDeposit guards balance before any mutation; an underfunded deposit attempt produces the localized error and leaves no Published ghost shift in storage.
findings.test: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts :: Part 4 — no ghost published shift

knownLimitations: Mock-only architecture: all authz is client-side (no server). Acceptable for the MVP demo; real server-side authorization is a known pre-existing deferred item.
localStorage is trusted: a user can edit their own wallet/ledger via devtools. Out of scope for a no-backend demo.
